title: Nykaa profit surges 207% as premiumisation drives beauty sales
summary: The Indian retailer and brand owner also announced the acquisition of SimplyNam, the premium colour cosmetics brand founded by celebrity makeup artist Namrata Son

extraction.key_fact: 인도 뷰티 유통사 Nykaa가 프리미엄 컬러 화장품 브랜드 SimplyNam 인수를 발표했다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: The Indian retailer and brand owner also announced the acquisition of SimplyNam, the premium colour cosmetics brand founded by celebrity makeup artist Namrata Son
